title: cerastium illyricum subsp. prolixum
intro: Cerastium illyricum subsp. prolixum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the carnation family, is a subspecies of the Cerastium illyricum species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium illyricum subsp. prolixum include its potential to act as an antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
